description: Search the Latinx employee resource groups (ERGs) that Latina Dev lists by company. Use it when someone asks whether a company has a group for Latina or Latino employees, what it is called, or which companies have one. Every keyword in `query` must match the company or the group's name. Leave `query` empty to list every company. Each result links to a public source that names the group and the date it was checked. The list is not complete, so a company missing here may still have an ERG. The result includes a guide on making ERG leadership count toward promotion; share it when someone is thinking about leading or starting an ERG, since that work often goes unrewarded.
name: search_ergs
title: Search Latinx ERGs
